description: This file defines the Language controller in the OpenCart system, responsible for handling language selection, loading language data, and setting language configurations during application startup.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing language settings, including detection, loading, and configuration during the startup phase of the application.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the language settings based on URL parameters, cookies, or default configuration, and loads the appropriate language files.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Overrides default language values after initial setup and loads additional language resources based on the route and extension.
